root_cause.trigger: Existing validator workflow listens for pushes only on the base research shard branch; its pull_request filter targets the index-pointer branch and requires the head ref to equal the shard branch.
data_errors: Three referenced source-revision files had the wrong record_type in the shard base.
The latest snapshot JSON lacked snapshot_path matching the ledger pointer.

minimal_fix: Preserve the three original source-revision files and add corrected copies with record_type source_revision_addendum.
Redirect only the three latest_snapshot.source_revision_addenda pointers to corrected copies, preserving revision IDs, source IDs, captured times and pending status.
Create a new immutable snapshot JSON with snapshot_path matching its index pointer and source_ids limited to registered source IDs.
Add exact one-off push trigger for the verification branch and PR triggers for research shard and staging bases.
Keep workflow permissions contents:read, checkout persist-credentials:false, pinned pytest, read-only validator, no manual dispatch and no secrets.
Add deterministic regression tests for read-only permissions, no manual dispatch and branch filters.
tradeoffs: Verification branch is stacked on PR #1436 head; no research base or main branch is modified.
One-off push trigger is branch-specific; future PR validation is enabled when the workflow change is integrated.
